reviews.text: Absolutely amazing vets, would not trust anyone else with my dog. Always so welcoming and professional. They always go above and beyond and are always at the end of the phone to answer any questions. Highly highly recommend
Great staff and service. Always so helpful.

Cannot recommend this vet clinic enough, highly professional, family originated and really care about their clients from the animal to the human. Prices are very reasonable too. The staff from the minute we joined the clinic have been incredible , always took the time to explain everything clearly, if ever unsure was always able to contact them to ask. If your looking for a vets in Fermoy look no further.
Out of hours vet friendly hospital knowledgeable very good well worth it the vet very professional and help me with ease
Highly professional and family-friendly practice. All team members are knowledgeable and friendly, making sure to take time to explain procedures and treatments. A great asset to the community.
Staff are amazing and have taken great care of our pups.
As always, a friendly inviting environment. Lovely staff, vet great with my cat and with explaining new procedures. Thanks guys 🙂 …
Very friendly staff amazing and clean office

I brought my 6 year old Irish Doodle and my 2 year old Sheepadoodle Doodle here for vaccinations and all the staff and vets are just fabulous. They go out of their way to calm my nervous dogs. Neither dog even noticed their injections. We've been through several other vets in the town but we can't recommend Milvalley VC high enough. They are just fab.
Fabulous practice The best of staff would do anything to help and put your worries at ease Couldn't recommend it enough
We have always been looked after. Those smiles and care make you feel special.

Would highly recommend this veterinary clinic , staff are absolutely fantastic, so knowledgeable and helpful. The vet was brilliant, brought me through the whole process and was willing to answer any questions I asked, as was the lovely lady at reception. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who needs a good veterinary clinic around fermoy .
